coreGaps.sample: Long, committing ridge in a very remote setting

coreGaps.name: Mazama Glacier Headwall

coreGaps.name: Ice Cliff Glacier

coreGaps.sample: steep firm ice and mixed terrain

coreGaps.name: Sitkum Glacier

coreGaps.sample: routefinding to gain the ridge

coreGaps.name: North Face

coreGaps.name: Northeast Buttress

coreGaps.sample: loose rock and dirty terrain on the upper pitches

coreGaps.name: Southwest Rib

coreGaps.name: East Ridge

coreGaps.name: West Ridge
coreGaps.sample: Rockfall on the approach traverse around 5,800 ft

coreGaps.name: Southwest Couloir
coreGaps.sample: Rockfall in late-season, snow-free conditions

coreGaps.name: South Face
coreGaps.sample: Loose rock low on the route

coreGaps.name: South Face
